title: ירושלים, הר חוצבים (Jerusalem, Har Hozevim)
author: N. Mai
location_note: Crusader farmhouse on the north slope of Har Hozevim. ESI15-070-har-hozevim (phase 1, R. Kletter) reports another excavation.
notes: Crusader farmhouse in two phases, Mamluk additions (rooms 1-2, penfold), temporary settlement.

features.subtype: round rock-cut pit (0.6 m diameter) in the courtyard floor

author: R. Abu Riya, B. Zissu
extra_quotes: והמתוארך אף הוא לשלהי המאה הב׳ לפסה״נ - המאה הא׳ .לסה״נ

features.subtype: burial caves AI, AII and B: standing pits with benches, kokhim, repositories; ossuary fragments, Herodian lamps
cave C with stepped door frame and standing pit (probed by robbers)
features.period: end of the Second Temple period (door design)
features.quote: עיצוב הפתח מלמד על תאריך בשלהי ימי הבית .השני

title: ירושלים, דרך העופל (Jerusalem, Ha-'Ofel Road)
author: R. Reich, E. Shukron
location_note: East of the Temple Mount along the Kidron.
notes: Second Temple houses with a vaulted cellar (second half of the 1st c. BCE-1st c. CE); broad rock-cut steps perhaps of a Roman road.

features.subtype: about ten rock-cut burial caves: narrow slab-covered shaft to a chamber with troughs; tombstones with crosses and Greek inscriptions
features.quote: שבו חצובות כעשר מערות קבורה מהתקופה .הביזאנטית

features.subtype: burial caves cut into the Second Temple houses, entered by built shafts (not excavated)
features.quote: נחצבו מערות קבורה אל תוך מבני המגורים

title: ירושלים, מעיין הגיחון (Jerusalem, Ha-Gihon Spring)
author: R. Reich, E. Shukron
notes: Stone vault over the lower stairway to the spring built in the Second Temple period; massive Iron Age fortification near the spring.
extra_quotes: ברור שהוא נחסם בעת בניית הקמרון בימי הבית .השני

features.subtype: narrow shaft cut along a natural fissure, ending c. 5 m above the spring; blocked with a rock plug
features.period: hewing date unknown; blocked when the vault was built in the Second Temple period
features.quote: שלאורכו נחצב פיר צר המסתיים בדיוק מעל .המעיין

features.subtype: caves 1 and 2 around a forecourt (kokhim, standing pit, repository) and cave 3 with benches and repository; no ossuaries
features.period: Second Temple period: cave 2 1st c. BCE-1st c. CE; cave 3 2nd-1st c. BCE; out of use when the Herodian low-level aqueduct was built
features.quote: המערות השייכות לעיר הקברים של ירושלים בימי הבית ,השני

features.subtype: bell-shaped cistern lined with modern cement cutting the forecourt stairway
features.quote: אשר נפגע על ידי בור מים ;מאוחר

title: ירושלים, כנסיית סט׳ פטרוס אין גליקנטו - 1995 (Jerusalem, St. Peter in Gallicantu - 1995)
author: F. Diez

features.subtype: drainage channel under the road, partly rock-cut
quarry (negatives of rectangular blocks) in square X

author: E. Assaf, Y. Billig
notes: Aqueduct from the Mamilla pool to the Towers' pool and a road along it.

features.quote: הוקמה בתקופה הביזאנטית או האומיית לכל

cisterns of houses in the north-east part of the street
features.quote: של בורות מים ושל מרתפי בתים משלהי המאה הי״ט

title: ירושלים, נווה שאנן (Jerusalem, Nave Sha'anan)
author: J. Seligman, A. Re'em
notes: INFERENCE of the excavators: the cisterns and quarrying belonged to the settlement at Giv'at Ram (Sheikh Badr).
extra_quotes: נראה שבורות המים וסימני החציבה היו שייכים ליישוב

features.subtype: rock-cut pear-shaped plastered cistern (4 m diameter, 4.25 m deep), square opening; medieval sherds on the floor
second cistern 30 m west, blocked, not excavated
quarrying marks of building stones 35 m south-west
features.quote: הובחנו סימני חציבה של אבני בנייה

title: ירושלים, עין כרם (Jerusalem, 'En Kerem)
author: J. Seligman, A. Re'em
notes: Round lime kiln, partly rock-cut, undated. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: ירושלים, גבעת חומה (Jerusalem, Giv'at Homa)
author: N. Mai
location_note: North slope of the stream from Giv'at Homa toward Mar Elias, 500 m south of Ramat Rahel.
notes: Two late Iron Age buildings (pillared house; tower); Roman-Byzantine finds in the upper fill washed down from the aqueduct.

features.subtype: tiny rock-cut plastered winepress (0.6 x 0.7 m) against the pillar wall; shallow rock-cut channels across rooms
remains of the aqueduct to Jerusalem on the same slope (mentioned, not excavated)
features.quote: על מדרון זה נמצאו גם שרידיה של אמת המים

unfinished rock-cut winepress with a feeding channel
rock-cut burial cave with forecourt, three kokhim and standing pit; 15 individuals; Byzantine use; Second Temple lamp nozzle

features.period: covering fill Late Roman and Byzantine

notes: Middle Bronze II village houses and late Iron Age farmsteads.

installations cut in the rock floor, earlier than the building, later blocked
features.period: earlier than the Iron Age building

features.period: end of the Iron Age (with the buildings)

author: O. Marder, H. Khalaileh, M. Peterson-Solimany, O. Barzilai

title: רכס שורק (Rekhes Soreq)
author: D. Weiss, B. Zissu
location_note: Isolated hill above the confluence of Nahal Soreq and Nahal Refa'im; at the western edge of the Z4 box.
notes: Two farmhouses, mainly Hellenistic pottery (also Iron II, Persian, Early Roman, Byzantine); round watchtower.
extra_quotes: בתחתית בור האיגום נמצאו שברים של שני קנקני אגירה מהתקופה הרומית .הקדומה

features.subtype: seven rock-cut winepresses on the hill slopes (three excavated: a twin press, a complex press with secondary pressing niches, a simple press)
features.period: no datable finds in the presses except Early Roman jars in winepress 2; assigned by the excavators to the Hellenistic and Early Roman (Hasmonean and Herodian) periods
features.quote: במהלך הסקר אותרו שבע גיתות חצובות במדרונות

features.subtype: beam-and-weights oil press installed in winepress 2 after it went out of use (crushing basin, oil vat)

title: סקר מבנים צלבניים (Frankish Buildings, Survey)
author: A. Boas
location_note: Survey of Crusader buildings in Akko, Achziv (outside the region), Jerusalem (171/132), Lifta (168/134) and Moza (165/133); the only eligible feature is at Lifta.

features.subtype: oil presses in two vaulted halls of a Crusader manor house
dwelling cave (20-25 m2) with two floors: lower crushed-chalk floor on bedrock with Early Roman sherds and a stone bowl; upper floor of terra rossa
features.period: Early Roman (end of the Second Temple period); later Byzantine and Umayyad
features.quote: נתגלה ממצא דל של שברי כלי חרס מהתקופה הרומית הקדומה
